name: landtrust-connect
description: LandTrust Connect — an AI-based evidence-gated land ownership verification, secure owner interaction and autonomous transaction risk resolution system (Review-2 research prototype).

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.seed: cd backend && python3 -m app.seed.generate && python3 -m app.seed.seed --reset
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "cd backend && python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000" "cd frontend && npm run start"
